messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: service=inference-gateway | symptom=HTTP 5xx rate spike (1m) | threshold=5% | region=global | incident=INC-1834567001
PagerDuty: Alert fired — incident INC-1834567001. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx
Maya: acked — I'm on the page. grabbing metrics now.
Raj: saw a small spike in eu-west1 earlier. Checking k8s events & pod restarts.
kim: pinging oncall if we need to scale quickly. I can bump replicas in dedicated pools.
Maya: logs show 502s from proxy->kvcache timeouts. dumping a tail of ingress logs:
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-17T03:45:01Z","path":"/v1/generate","status":502,"err":"upstream read timeout","pod":"ingress-12"}
{"ts":"2026-03-17T03:45:02Z","path":"/v1/chat","status":502,"err":"kvcache eviction","pod":"ingress-13"}
```
Raj: KV cache eviction + high tail latency — could be KVM hot-shard. Checking memory pressure & evictions.
oncall-tilt: I'm at my desk. I'll take primary if needed. Can we try a rolling restart of ingress pods in eu-west1 first?
Maya: rolling restart started on eu-west1 ingresses (kubectl rollout restart deploy/ingress -n prod). Also enabling cache warmup bypass for hot keys.
kim: scaled dedicated-inference-pool-usw2 from 8->12 replicas to reduce routing pressure.
sre-rotation: noted customer 500 errors: ~18% of requests for wk-webhook clients; CS alerted. Maya please confirm impacted tenants.
Maya: working with CS (CS ticket #CS-8932). Early signal shows one enterprise tenant in EU sees increased 5xx; message draft ready.
Raj: after restart error rate dropped from 12% -> 3% in eu-west1. Still watching global.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Condition cleared (5xx rate < 5% over 2m) for service=inference-gateway. Auto-close scheduled.
Maya: keeping monitors at high sensitivity for 30m. filing postmortem stub: infra->kvcache hot-shard, mitigation: make prefix-level cache shard awareness and improve eviction policy.
kim: handing off to night oncall @leo in 20m. leo — please watch the dashboards and the CS ticket.
leo: taking handoff. will monitor, will follow up in morning with PMs. :thumbsup: 
Maya: thanks team. closing this thread — follow-up postmortem to be tracked in #postmortems.
